raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the generational relationship by naming Guy de Beauchamp, 10th Earl of Warwick (the great-grandfather), instead of the correct paternal grandfather, Thomas de Beauchamp, 11th Earl of Warwick. This error occurred despite the WebSurfer’s sourced page explicitly stating that William Beauchamp (Richard’s father) was the son of Thomas (11th Earl), indicating a confusion between grandfather and great-grandfather and a premature, incorrect conclusion.
